entities.name: Santa Maria in Betlem
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The church of Santa Maria in Betlem, founded around 1130, stands in the characteristic district of the Borgo of Pavia, located, after the Ponte Coperto, on the other bank of the Ticino river from the city center.
